title: Sum of Roots Without Solving Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Diya's homework: for 2x² - 7x + 3 = 0, find the sum and the product of the roots. She solved the whole equation. Aarav read both answers, 7/2 and 3/2, straight off the equation in two seconds. How? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 4, Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations) we find the sum and the product of the roots hiding inside a, b and c.

You will watch the curve y = x² - 4x + c lift as c counts up: the roots slide together and even become complex, but their midpoint stays pinned, so the sum never changes, while the product follows c exactly. We prove α + β = -b/a and αβ = c/a in four small steps, read the signs of the roots from the sum and product, and find α² + β² with an area picture, without ever finding α or β. Two pause-and-think questions, the exam trap with the minus sign, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Note: the zeroes and coefficients relationship appears in the Class 10 NCERT text; in Class 11 it is part of the JEE Main syllabus but not of the current rationalised NCERT text.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:

Next episode (Ep 48): Formation of Quadratic Equations from Roots. We run it backwards: give any two roots, and we build their equation.
